outline.rationale: The user is a complete beginner whose goal is querying and analyzing data, so the outline starts with the only conceptual foundation they truly need (how relational data is structured) before moving into hands-on querying. I included a setup node because they have no environment yet, but kept it lightweight (no admin internals). The core of the map is a progression of analysis skills—SELECT, WHERE, aggregation/GROUP BY, JOINs—which are the MECE building blocks of reading data, ordered by dependency. A 'shape and clean results' node captures the practical glue (dates, CASE, subqueries) needed for real analysis without becoming a full SQL reference. The final synthesis node ties it together by walking from a real question to a query, matching the practical, analysis-focused intent. I deliberately excluded administration (tuning, replication, users), heavy data modeling/schema design, indexing internals, and theory, per the confirmed understanding.
